handover.scope: Session handover: viewer/projection work, CW export, CW conformance gate, CW authoring completeness, and deterministic Event/Link playback.

authority.rule: Project conversations are the authoritative specification. GitHub is implementation/current state.
derived_sources: Tests = executable evidence derived from conversation-locked CW requirements
authority.forbidden_assumption: Do not claim authoritative specs live in the repository or a special branch.

canonical_model.name: CCF
canonical_model.note: Do not expand CCF unless exact expansion is explicitly established in project discussions.
canonical_model.identity_rule: Ruleset switching changes projection/requirements/validation/authoring affordances, not canonical identity.
canonical_model.aigmos_rule: AIGMos is not a separate Ruleset; it is a concrete software system represented as CCF satisfying CW.
canonical_model.cw_scope: CW is sufficient to describe all software semantics relevant to Structure.

architecture.structure_invariant: If a Ruleset can describe it, Structure should be able to create it, edit it, validate it, visualize it, import it, export it and, where a mapping exists, compare it.
architecture.no_guessing: Structure must not guess semantic meaning. Ambiguous data stays unresolved/candidate/unsupported.
architecture.graph_rule: Canonical semantics are the architecture; graph is a projection.

viewer_3d_contract.locked_rule: Everything represented inside the scene/view is 3D. DOM is only editor/application chrome.

node_local_layout.event_list: left of Entity with small gap
node_local_layout.event_in: left of Props at Props vertical center
node_local_layout.event_out: right of Props at Props vertical center

props.expanded_control: Only tiny close button in Props top-right corner
props.hierarchy: Props belongs under Entity in the 3D hierarchy

event_io.semantic_type: Shared Link projection points, not Event Property instances
event_io.count_rule: Exactly one Event IN and one Event OUT visual point per Entity regardless of Event count
event_io.size_rule: 10% of previous node-sized marker; only enough to be visible; no text labels
event_io.position_rule: Event IN left / Event OUT right of Props, same Y at Props vertical center
event_io.event_rows_rule: Individual Event rows never create own input/output ports

baseline.rule: Canonical links remain visible with slow baseline directional flow.

event_trace.rule: Event playback overlays a transient trace on the same canonical route and never invents routes.
event_trace.current_events: Concurrent runs live in currentEvents[] and use stable distinct trace colors.
event_trace.merge: Earliest canonical arrival wins; ties by stable edge order
event_trace.visual: Growing colored segment + small head point; target highlights are bounded activation windows

determinism_fix.old_bug: Depth-based timing let different branch lengths jump to the same graph depth; aggregated route progress could visually teleport.
determinism_fix.new_rule: Scheduler is predecessor-completion-driven. Depth is descriptive only.
determinism_fix.route_aggregation_fix: No route-level max(progress); active canonical edges draw deterministic partial segments, completed uses leave a dim trail.

playback_runtime.semantic_boundary: Playback timing is view/runtime state, not CW semantic authority.

cw_export.shared_boundary: Export CW and Publish Abstraction share canonicalSemanticPayload().
cw_export.workflow: Structure -> Export CW -> send JSON back for analysis

cw_conformance_gate.purpose: Tests prove conversation-derived CW invariants instead of snapshotting implementation details.
cw_conformance_gate.principle: If Structure lacks a CW capability, fix Structure; do not weaken the test.
cw_conformance_gate.requirement_registry: CW requirement IDs require concrete test coverage.
cw_conformance_gate.known_result: Gate exposed missing Data/Function authoring and implementation was fixed instead of weakening tests.

function.ref_rule: I/O accepts only resolvable canonical refs

cw_authoring.ruleset_resolution: Resolve by property_type_ref and require exactly one match; never guess.
cw_authoring.delete_safety: Block delete when Link or Function still references the Property.
